proposedNonHuntMaterials.name: ヒラナギの葉
proposedNonHuntMaterials.description: 灰緑の平たい葉を重ね、乾いた礫の間に根を張る草。採集するのは外側の葉。
proposedNonHuntMaterials.proposedUse: 里の薬房で使う回復液の原料候補。調合レシピは別途設計する。
proposedNonHuntMaterials.rankNote: Source does not assign a rank; quest stars must not be used as rank.

runtimeStatus.monsterGradeLootExceptGaldros: Only first-grade material tables implemented; higher-grade materials require design and implementation.

rulesForNewDesign: Do not conflate four ranks with five equipment tiers.
Do not infer rank from quest star count.
Respect species native first rank when determining craft availability, or flag lower-rank versions as explicit new design.
All 86 includes eight juveniles; earlier no-full-set policy must be revisited for this explicit request.
Gathering/mining/insect materials do not currently exist in runtime inventory. New IDs must remain proposals.
Reuse exact resource proposal IDs where intended, but adopting them for equipment recipes is a new design decision.
Never treat loaned cargo as crafting inventory.
Natural ore must remain distinct from monster biological crystals and shells.
Retain existing permanent monster IDs even where displayed name changed.
Preserve existing weapon/armor IDs and 48 linear recipe chain.
